changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO clinlims.system_module_url (id, url_path, system_module_id) SELECT nextval('clinlims.system_module_url_seq'), u.url_path, m.id FROM (VALUES ('/ReceivedOrders'), ('/ReceivedOrders/count'), ('/ReceivedOrders/detail')) AS u(url_path) CROSS JOIN clinlims.system_module m WHERE m.name IN ('ElectronicOrderView', 'LocalOrderEntry') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM clinlims.system_module_url x WHERE x.url_path = u.url_path AND x.system_module_id = m.id);
